subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw replace Node’s native bootstrap glob collection with this custom cooperative walker, accepting ownership of its long-term cross-platform matching and ordering compatibility?
rationale: The performance improvement is well demonstrated and no narrow defect remains, but tests cannot settle whether the repository wants to own a custom implementation of a dependency-level filesystem contract on a session-context-sensitive path.

options.title: Accept after exact-head proof
options.body: Approve the custom walker after representative cross-platform glob-parity checks and a live embedded-run liveness capture pass on the current head.

options.title: Narrow the implementation
options.body: Keep asynchronous file reads and diagnostics but redesign traversal around a maintained asynchronous glob implementation or isolated worker so OpenClaw owns less matching semantics.

options.title: Pause the replacement
options.body: Leave current behavior unchanged until a smaller dependency-backed or worker-isolation approach is available.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Approve the custom walker after representative cross-platform glob-parity checks and a live embedded-run liveness capture pass on the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace-boundary merger and strongest available owner for the repository-level compatibility decision.
